50509761.DESCRIPTION: Direct binding to His6-tagged FABP4 (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) cells by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.6. Isothermal: Experiments were performed on an ITC200 instrument (Microcal, GE Healthcare). Experiments were carried out at 25 °C while stirring at 750 rpm in an ITC buffer (50 mM of NaH2PO4, pH 7.5; 50 mM of NaCl). The syringe was loaded with a solution of the protein sample (200 μM in an ITC buffer). All titrations were conducted using an initial control injection of 0.5 μL followed by 19 identical injections of 2 μL for a duration of 4 s (per injection) and a spacing of 180 s between injections. The heat of dilution was determined by independent titrations (the protein into the buffer) and was subtracted from independent titrations of proteins into the buffer. The collected data were evaluated using a single binding site model and the MicroCal™ Origin software. Thermodynamic parameters were calculated (ΔG = ΔH − TΔS = −RTlnK, where ΔG, ΔH and ΔS are the changes in free energy, enthalpy and entropy of binding, respectively).
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) analysis for ligand binding to FABP4. (A) The titration of FABP4 with 3. (B) The titration of FABP4 with 33b. The stoichiometry between ligand and protein was set to one for all analyses.
